name: tabo
description: Firefox extension that groups loose tabs by recency and unloads unused ones.

scripts.start: npx --yes web-ext@8 run --source-dir . --ignore-files test docs 'test/**' 'docs/**' package.json CLAUDE.md README.md
scripts.build: npx --yes web-ext@8 build --source-dir . --overwrite-dest --ignore-files test docs 'test/**' 'docs/**' package.json CLAUDE.md README.md .gitignore .env
scripts.sign: npx --yes web-ext@8 sign --source-dir . --channel unlisted --ignore-files test docs 'test/**' 'docs/**' package.json CLAUDE.md README.md .gitignore .env
